notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition's toughness is equal to or less than 10 plus Ezio's power.
An opponent cannot block Ezio.
Tree of Perdition and Ezio do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Deal combat damage to that opponent using Ezio.
Ezio triggers, causing you to pay {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} to have that opponent lose the game.
